The structure of La2Mg28Mn2 (reduced formula LaMg14Mn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that all La, Mg, and Mn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Mn, and La–Mg contacts dominating the coordination. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while La–Mg and Mg–Mn pairs exhibit edge sharing.
